messages:
Lea (Product): Hey team, odd one 16. I flew to Oslo for a 2-day client workshop and my partner had to come too because we couldn't secure childcare last minute. I paid for two dinners and an extra night at the hotel on my personal card. Booking REF: OSLO-4433. Can I claim: 1) the business dinner only (we ate as a group but spouse joined), 2) the extra night (childcare-related) as a reimbursable travel expense or is that personal? Also curious about splitting per-diem on full days split between business & personal. Ken is traveling and slow to respond. Who can approve if he doesn't get to it today?

Aaron (People Ops): Short: business meals for employees on company business are reimbursable for the employee portion only. Spouse meals are personal. For the extra night due to childcare, generally not reimbursable unless there's documented operational need (e.g., client meeting next morning impossible otherwise). Per-diem: partial days should be prorated; we prefer receipts for meals. If manager is unavailable, use finance-approvals@redwood.com with cc people-ops for delegation up to $1,000.

Marta (Finance): Adding specifics: - Upload full hotel folio and dinner receipt. If folio shows two guests but no itemization, Finance will prorate dinner by number of people or ask for an itemized merchant invoice. - Extra night: please provide a short note explaining childcare issue and any evidence (e.g., booking cancellation, message thread) so we can consider exception. We don't cover family travel unless pre-approved. - Per-diem: we allow daily per-diem only if you opt out of submitting receipts; do not double-claim receipts + per-diem.

Lea (Product): I have hotel folio (single line total NOK 4,200), dinner receipt (table for 4, NOK 1,150) but the merchant didn't split names. I also have a screenshot of a childcare booking cancellation explaining partner couldn't find coverage.

Marta (Finance): Good. For the dinner: since it was a group meal with clients, Finance will allow the employee portion. If the table included spouse, we will subtract one seat at menu price. If merchant doesn't itemize, we typically prorate by covers (1/4 in your case) unless you can estimate spouse's meal cost. For the extra night: upload the childcare cancellation screenshot and add a note "childcare prevented earlier return; request exception". We'll route to approvals. If Ken doesn't respond within 48h, finance-approvals can provisionally approve up to NOK 10,000 per policy when CC'd with people-ops.

Ken (Manager): I'm on travel but see this. I confirm the client schedule did not require the extra night; normally wouldn't approve extra family nights. That said, given the childcare cancellation and short notice, I delegate approval to Aaron for a one-time exception to cover the extra night net of spouse charges. Aaron, please sign off if you agree.

Aaron (People Ops): I approve the exception to reimburse the extra night (employee portion only). Conditions: reimburse net hotel minus estimated spouse room share (prorated by guest count) and employee meal share only. Please submit within 30 days and tag me and Ken. Marta, please process VAT as usual if supplier invoice includes our VAT ID.

ReceiptBot: Reminder 12 submit within 30 days. Required uploads: hotel folio PDF, dinner receipt, childcare cancellation screenshot, booking confirmation. Tag: "family-exception", "split-meal". Help: https://redwood.example/docs/expenses#family-exceptions

Lea (Product): Thanks all 12 uploaded folio + receipt + cancellation screenshot and tagged Aaron + Ken. Marked expense description: "childcare cancellation; extra night exception approved by Aaron".
